statusDetail: The site firewall served an Access Restricted interstitial to the raw-CDP audit browser. Per the audit method, recon stopped because no product surface or representative route could be reached.

page.notes: Only the firewall interstitial was observable; this is not treated as the JanitorAI product UI.

artifacts.caption: Desktop recon capture showing the JanitorAI Access Restricted firewall interstitial.
Rendered DOM of the firewall response; title and H1 are Access Restricted.
Evaluate probe recording the firewall message, available links, title, H1, and URL.

checkOutcomes.method: Planned compare heap snapshots for retained growth - a baseline, then one taken after repeating the interaction with `--interact` about 10x (the memory-tracer methodology: baseline -> repeat -> post -> compare). Performance.getMetrics (JSHeapUsedSize, Nodes) across the same before/after window is corroboration.
